answer_1.quote: The top-ranked snippets can also be used as a starting point for multi-document query-focused summarization, as in the BIOASQ challenge.

answer_2.quote: We measure Mean Average Precision (MAP) for document and snippet retrieval, which are the official BIOASQ evaluation measures.

answer_4.quote: These claims are also supported by human evaluation on two test batches of BIOASQ 7 (2019).
answer_4.guideline: Experts judged the relevance of documents and snippets to the questions.
